timeline.body:
This change introduces null handling in the OrdinalsGroupingOperator, replacing the current behavior which skips null keys. Ordinals are now incremented by 1, with 0 being used to represent null ordinals.

Closes #100109

timeline.author: Nhat Nguyen

diff.patch:
@@ -569,3 +569,12 @@ ca:l | cx:l | l:i
 1    | 1    | 5
 1    | 1    | null
 ;
+
+aggsWithoutStats
+from employees | stats by gender | sort gender;
+
+gender:keyword
+F
+M
+null
+;

timeline.body: I moved this class to OrdinalsGroupingOperator since it's only used by this class and the new behavior (add 1 to the ordinals). We can generalize it later if necessary.
No need to delete docs in these tests. The index should be deleted after each test.
LGTM - Thanks for the quick turn-around Nhat!
